title: Genotyping of rs3824662 Polymorphism in GATA3 Gene by Allele-Specific PCR
author: Nafiul Huda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k45cyy6

steps.title: Assemble allele‑specific PCR mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube, prepare a 15 µL reaction containing forward outer primer (5’-TTGCAAATGGAAGAGGGTCT-3’, final 200 nM), reverse outer primer (5’-ACCCTGCAAATGAGAGGAAA-3’, final 200 nM), the allele‑specific inner primer (either G‑specific 5’-TGAGATTAAACACAAACACGtTG-3’ or T‑specific 5’-CTGAGATTAAACACAAACACGaTT-3’, final 200 nM), appropriate PCR buffer, dNTPs, DNA polymerase (as recommended by the enzyme supplier), and the DNA template; bring the total volume to 15 µL with nuclease‑free water and mix gently.

substeps.instruction: Add forward outer primer to achieve 200 nM final concentration.
Add reverse outer primer to achieve 200 nM final concentration.
Add the chosen allele‑specific inner primer (G‑specific or T‑specific) to achieve 200 nM final concentration.
Add PCR buffer, dNTPs, and DNA polymerase according to the enzyme kit instructions.
Add the DNA template (amount as per upstream extraction protocol).
Add nuclease‑free water to bring the reaction to a total of 15 µL.
Mix the reaction gently and briefly centrifuge to collect contents.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermal cycler and run the following program: 95 °C for 5 min (initial denaturation); 40 cycles of 95 °C for 30 s, 55 °C for 45 s, and 72 °C for 1 min; followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 5 min; then hold at 4 °C.
